name: Assamite Sorcery (Whispers of the Heavens) — Basic — Call Down the Hunter's Moon

system.description:
This power grants the sorcerer a sense of the most auspicious time to undertake a particular act. The sorcerer is free to ignore the omen, but her chances for success rise considerably if she heeds it.

The sorcerer names the act in question aloud. On a success, she learns the best night within the next lunar season to attempt an extended task, or the best hour before dawn to attempt a more immediate one. If the character acts at the appointed time, the player gains bonus temporary Willpower Traits equal to the successes scored, tracked separately and lost at the end of the night or on completion of the task. This power may only be invoked once per task, and cannot apply to something resolved with a single challenge. A small group (no more than the sorcerer's Leadership rating) may share the boon if each donates a Blood Trait consumed in the rite; each then gains the same bonus Willpower.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
